concerns.text: T004 computes geometric diagnostics as `trustworthiness(X_highdim_sampled, X_pca30, n_neighbors=15)` and the reverse direction — both require the PCA-30 embedding, which is only produced by T005 (`data/embeddings/{dataset_id}_PCA.csv`). T004 is ordered BEFORE T005, so at T004 execution time `X_pca30` does not exist: a hard consumer-before-producer violation. Either move the geometric-diagnostic computation into/after T005, or redefine the diagnostics as embedding-free (which would also resolve the analyze-report's Constitution VI concern).

T008 says it will 'reuse the sweep from T006', but T006's outputs (`data/clustering/{dataset_id}_{method}_clusters.csv`, `fidelity_results.csv`) persist only the optimal resolution's labels/scores, not the per-resolution sweep. T008's fallback ('or recomputing deterministically') covers this, but the primary phrasing implies an artifact that no producer task emits; reword to make recomputation the specified path or add a sweep artifact to T006's outputs.
